subject: Gaza Ceasefire Resolution Endorsement
overview: The Medford Human Rights Commission discussed upcoming community events, commissioner recruitment, and meeting facilitation before hearing public comments urging action on the conflict in Gaza. Following the public comment period, the commission voted to endorse the Medford City Council's resolution calling for a ceasefire in Israel and Gaza.

items.title: Call to order and meeting touchstones
items.summary: Commissioners introduced themselves and read the meeting touchstones.

items.title: Lunar New Year event recap
items.summary: Commissioners recapped the recent Lunar New Year celebration, noting attendance of 575 people and discussing the need for a larger venue next year.

items.title: HRC mission, ordinance review, and meeting facilitation
items.summary: The commission discussed reviewing the city ordinance governing their quorum and operations, and agreed to consider rotating meeting facilitation among members.

items.title: Raise the Age campaign invitation
items.summary: The commission agreed to invite representatives from the Raise the Age campaign to present at their March meeting.

items.title: Upcoming events and commission recruitment
items.summary: Members discussed the upcoming Black History Month event, rescheduled the Belinda Sutton petition reading to March 30, and considered recruiting youth to fill three vacant commission seats.

items.title: Discussion on statements and public comment
items.summary: After commissioners discussed approaches to issuing official public statements, several members of the public urged the commission to speak out against genocide and take a stand for a ceasefire in Gaza.

items.title: Endorsement of City Council ceasefire resolution
items.summary: The commission voted to endorse the Medford City Council's resolution calling for a ceasefire in Israel and Gaza and agreed to send a formal letter to the council and the mayor.
